Recorded native package fixtures for L11
=======================================

The JSON files encode lindm.inventory.v1.PackageBatch, selected unchanged from
NativeObservation packages emitted by the maintained lab vm inspect command.
Only package records are retained; local accounts, network addresses, hardware
serials and other unrelated host details are deliberately excluded. Formatting
and the PackageBatch envelope are the only transformations. These are selected
inventory subsets, not claims to represent every package on the source guest.

  source package identity. Retained openssh-client and openssh-server are both
  1:9.6p1-3ubuntu13.19, source openssh at the same version. USN-6859-1 fixes the
  earlier distro backport 1:9.6p1-3ubuntu13.3, so neither recorded package is
  affected even though its upstream OpenSSH version remains 9.6p1.
  VM: x86_64 KVM, QEMU 8.2.2, SeaBIOS 1.16.3, virtio-blk, TPM absent. This is
  emulator/VM inventory evidence, not physical or graphical certification.

  Package collection: 2026-10-09T22:55:22.975840845Z through 2026-10-09T22:55:23.040673326Z
  Native oracle independently matched all 427 RPM package records. Retained
  sudo is 0:1.9.17-7.p2.fc44. FEDORA-2026-7d4732cbab fixes the distro backport
  0:1.9.17-10.p2.fc44 (CVE-2026-96512), so this actual installed package remains
  affected without treating the unchanged upstream 1.9.17 version as proof.
  VM: x86_64 KVM, QEMU 8.2.2, SeaBIOS 1.16.3. This is emulator/VM inventory
  evidence, not physical or graphical certification.

The deterministic database replay controls receipt/collection timestamps to
exercise freshness independently of the retained package versions. Vendor feed
subsets remain explicitly partial, so absence of a finding is never promoted to
a whole-device clean claim. Vendor fixture provenance and native comparator test
sources are recorded separately in ../feed/testdata/provenance.txt.

  non-modular and newer than RHSA-2024:6783's fixed 1:3.0.7-28.el9_4.
  This guest was unregistered: CPE identified RHEL 9, the release lock was
  unavailable, and successful native dnf4 discovery returned no enabled repos.
  The replay therefore MUST report rhel_platform_stream_unavailable, not invent

  Host details outside the retained platform subset are explicitly unavailable
  in the replay envelope. No synthetic enabled repository is attributed to this
  VM. Controlled standard/EUS/E4S database fixtures are separately labeled tests.
  This x86_64 KVM guest is emulated/virtual inventory evidence, not physical
  qualification, entitlement verification, or a graphical-session claim.
